limitations: Age 75Y and sex male come from Cellosaurus (CVCL_0021), not from the paper
User-defined canavanine (+1.979 Da on R) variable modification has no Unimod or PSI-MOD term and is omitted from modification parameters
sample_explanation.csv has a 'no Arg 48 hours' condition not named in the paper Methods
Acquisition method DDA inferred from the Universal Method and Sequest search, not read from a stated field
PD_results.zip (49.7 GB) was not opened; modifications taken from pep.xml workflow header
Validator error 'study sample not found in pride' is a cache-only artifact; PRIDE:0001013 is study sample in live OLS4

Per-run SILAC label is a mixed state: per paper Table 1 the light runs LUM02044-46 are ~33.9% heavy/65.9% light, heavy runs 97.2% heavy, canavanine 24h 83.6% heavy/6.5% light/9.9% canavanine, canavanine 48h 76.9/6.3/16.8; one row per run kept, label is the dominant/pre-labelled form
Heavy label for the no-Arg runs LUM02040-42 has no paper support (condition named only in sample_explanation.csv; Table 1 and PRIDE list 4 conditions)
The other SILAC channel of each run is marked unused and is not asserted absent from the spectra
Canavanine +1.97927 Da on R (UnimodAccession 0) omitted, so modification columns do not reflect the study's central search target
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated in the paper text (supplement S1 and PD_results.zip not opened)
RAW headers of all 15 files read by the reviewer (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, CID, 35%, ion trap); acquisition dates not recoverable (all carry method creation time 2/9/2017)
Culture medium is free text (NCIT warning); Arg level not encoded because paper Methods and Results disagree
Cell line disease glioblastoma from the paper; Cellosaurus says astrocytoma

One row per run, no extra SILAC channel rows: paper gives only aggregate incorporation; the 2-3 rows per raw file rule is for paired multiplexed channels, extra rows would assert an undescribed design
Heavy label of the no-Arg runs rests on pep.xml counts (9643 heavy of Arg peptides), not on the paper; that medium is a bare Arg-free medium and its prelabelling is unverified
characteristics[culture medium] is the shared base medium on all rows including Arg-free ones; per-condition Arg level only in the treatment column
Alkylation reagent kept not available: PRIDE MOD:00397 (iodoacetamide-derivatized residue) makes iodoacetamide plausible but neither protocol nor paper text states it
